meta.name: render-hypermotion
meta.description: Assemble the FREE steps of the product-hypermotion + kinetic-typography video format — dice ONE Seedance 2.0 hypermotion clip into 5-6 segments and intercut them with PIL kinetic-typography spec/CTA cards (italic skew, 1.08x outline echo, 3D extrusion, slam-with-shake, inversion flash) plus a real-logo PIL end card (base64-decoded from the brand SVG), center-crop 1:1 to 9:16, and explicit-map mux a music bed. Deterministic, FREE (PIL + FFmpeg), no paid calls, the real logo and spec typography stay pixel-crisp. The paid steps (the ONE Seedance i2v, the music) are separate capabilities; the recipe orchestrates them. Use for the product-hypermotion format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将产品动效视频片段与动态排版卡片自动合成短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把AI生成的动效片段自动剪辑成带排版卡片的短视频。
copy.tagline_en: Assemble product motion clips with kinetic typography into short videos automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically edit AI-generated motion clips into short videos with typography cards.

howto.what: 将一段产品超动态视频剪辑成5-6段，与文字卡片交替拼接，生成一个约20-30秒的竖屏广告视频。文字卡片和结尾Logo均由PIL渲染，音乐由你另外提供。
howto.when: 当你需要制作产品超动态+动态排版广告视频，且已准备好一段Seedance 2.0超动态视频和音乐时触发。

say.text: 用这个产品超动态视频和文字卡片，生成一个25秒的广告。
把这段超动态视频切成6段，插入5张规格卡片，加上结尾Logo。
使用config.json中的配置，生成最终视频。

howto.what_en: Dice ONE Seedance 2.0 hypermotion clip into 5-6 segments, intercut with PIL kinetic-typography spec/CTA cards and a real-logo end card, center-crop 1:1 to 9:16, and mux a music bed. Output: ~20-30s vertical ad, FREE (PIL + FFmpeg).
howto.when_en: When you need a product-hypermotion + kinetic-typography ad and have the ONE hypermotion clip and music bed ready.

say_en.text: Use this hypermotion clip and spec cards to generate a 25s ad.
Dice the clip into 6 segments, intercut with 5 spec cards, add end card.
Use config.json to render the final video.
